laiDetails.initiationProtocol: Microsphere depot has a 3-week effective release lag after the first injection. Continue oral risperidone for at least 21 days post first injection.

halfLife.notes: Effective elimination half-life of total exposure ≈ 25 days (depot kinetics). Plasma levels peak ~3 weeks post-injection; steady state by ~8 weeks of dosing. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

activeMetabolite.name: 9-OH-risperidone (paliperidone)
activeMetabolite.notes: Same active metabolite as oral risperidone. Marketed independently as paliperidone. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

cypInteractions.switchingRelevance: Same CYP profile as oral risperidone. Strong CYP2D6 inhibitors (paroxetine, fluoxetine) raise levels meaningfully; depot persistence amplifies the consequence of inhibitor co-prescription. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

metabolicRisk.notes: Similar metabolic burden to oral risperidone. Monitor weight, glucose, lipids quarterly. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

lai.notes: This entry IS the LAI. Oral risperidone is a separate drug entry.

reboundPsychosisRisk.notes: Long depot tail provides intrinsic taper after last injection — relapse risk emerges weeks later if no maintenance plan. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

formulationNotes: Microsphere suspension reconstituted at point of care. Deltoid or gluteal IM. Cold-chain handling required. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
